name: 91731 · El Monte, CA
findings: ZIP 91731 (El Monte) has 155 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91731 (El Monte) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
